summary: Dynamic and performance-driven Flutter Developer with industry experience in architecting and delivering high-scale, cross-platform mobile applications. Specialized in building robust, production-level solutions with integrations for AI/ML (Google ML Kit, OpenAI), IoT ecosystems (Tuya Smart), and complex third-party services. Adept at full-lifecycle development, from initial architecture (MVVM, Provider, Repository Pattern) to secure global deployment. Committed to engineering clean, maintainable code and premium user experiences that drive market engagement.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science

highlights.description: Contributing to the development of production-level Flutter applications, ensuring high performance and responsive UI/UX across Android and iOS platforms.
Collaborating with senior developers to implement scalable application structures and efficient state management solutions.
Worked on 5+ projects within the company, contributing to development, feature implementation, and performance optimization.
Engaged in an intensive software engineering program, focusing on real-world engineering practices, collaborative development, and technical problem-solving.

details.integrations: Integrated Stripe for payments, CometChat for real-time messaging, and Firebase (Auth, Cloud Messaging, Remote Config) for mission-critical services.
details.core_features: Developed synchronized court bookings, automated tournament matchmaking, and location-based search using Google Maps and Geolocator APIs.

details.iot_integration: Achieved real-time device control and PM2.5 monitoring by integrating Tuya Smart SDK and architecting native bridges (MethodChannels/EventChannels).
details.background_tasks: Implemented persistent synchronization and home screen widget updates using native background services (BGTaskScheduler for iOS).
details.automation: Engineered smart scenes, sophisticated scheduling systems, and dynamic weather integration via Google Cloud APIs.

details.ai_ml: Developed an AI food recognition system using Google ML Kit for real-time image labeling and automated nutritional data extraction.
details.data_persistence: Implemented a high-performance offline layer using Hive NoSQL database for a seamless user experience without internet connectivity.
details.monetization: Integrated Google Mobile Ads, In-App Purchases (IAP), and Firebase suite for performance monitoring and user engagement.

details.ai_diagnostic: Leveraged Google ML Kit and OpenAI APIs to provide high-accuracy species data and treatment solutions.
details.subscription_model: Engineered a multi-tier subscription system for Apple and Google Stores, managing trial logic and real-time purchase synchronization.
details.cloud_control: Built a dynamic UI and ad-management system via Firebase Remote Config for real-time app behavior adjustments.

details.functionality: Enabled real-time machinery booking, listing management for tools/seeds, and a verified labor network with secure in-app chat.
details.accessibility: Designed an intuitive interface for low-literacy users with offline capabilities and live weather updates for optimized farming.
